plans.idea: Faithful banner split like the original: the headline sits on the left and the Shop pill on the right, both centred on the vertical axis, with equal left and right insets so the strip reads left to right with no dead gap after the button.
Centred lockup: the headline and the Shop pill are grouped tightly as one unit in the middle of the strip, with balanced purple space on both sides, so the message and the action read as one phrase.

Two-column grid: a large dominant headline fills the left two-thirds column starting at the left inset, and the CTA sits centred in the right-third column, so headline size carries the hierarchy and the CTA has its own bay.
